decision.explanation: Two distinct named individuals are presented as spouses of Giuseppe Persiani in separate documents. Document d1 (D1S3) explicitly identifies Julie Margaret-Anne Beuth as 'his wife,' while document d2 (D2S2) refers to Fanny Tacchinardi Persiani as Giuseppe’s spouse and provides historical narrative of their romantic and artistic partnership. Since both names appear in different documents and are not shown to be conflicting descriptions of the same person, they are treated as distinct valid answers.
